sources: Authored in-house for three.ws on 2026-11-16. Every image is a synthetic SVG drawn from the spec in this file and rasterised to PNG at eval time, so no photograph, dataset or third-party image is used and the ground truth is exact by construction.
Digits are drawn as seven-segment bars (render.kind = "digits") rather than text, so the images do not depend on whatever fonts the host has installed.
notes: Each item is sent as a base64 PNG data URL with the question. `expect` grades the answer; `format` checks the one-word output contract the question states.

items.question: What colour is the square? Answer with one word.
What colour is the circle? Answer with one word.
What colour is the background of this image? Answer with one word.
What shape is drawn in the image? Answer with one word.
How many sides does the shape have? Answer with a number.
How many circles are in the image? Answer with a number.
